layers.name: Model
layers.description: Manages the data, logic, and rules of the application. Handles database interactions and state.

layers.name: View
layers.description: Any output representation of information. Renders the UI or formats API JSON responses.

layers.name: Controller
layers.description: Accepts input and converts it to commands for the Model or View. Contains routing and orchestration logic.

rules.reason: Controllers modify the Model state based on user input.
Controllers pass data to Views to be rendered.
Views are allowed to read Model data to render it (Passive View pattern).
